note: The size of the viewer bundle every reader downloads, gzipped: the viewer's own code and every dependency in it, together. A bar is the claim the project makes, and it moves only when a change is worth the bytes; docs/viewer.md section 12 records the basis and what a slice does when it breaches. measured_gzip_bytes is what the ci.yml viewer job produced on x86_64 Linux on the date below, recorded beside the claim so a reader sees the headroom; another host emits slightly different bytes. The wasm headroom is deliberate: nine screens are still to land.

the wasm-bindgen bootstrap is under 12 KB gzipped
